country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. createdAt.description: When the party was added to the document

fields.description: Content blocks in position order when you pass `expand=fields`, and null otherwise. See the field endpoints for the per-type shapes.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

post.description:
Irreversibly delete a document: database rows, uploaded files, the sealed PDF, the signing certificate and the audit trail. There is no undo and no support path to recover it.

**Requirements:**
- The document must already be in the trash. Call `DELETE /api/v1/documents/{id}` first.
- Requires the `PERMANENTLY_DELETE_DOCUMENT` workspace permission, which is not part of the default document-permission set.
- Requires the `documents:delete` scope.

**Completed documents:** allowed, and the verify link printed into the sealed PDF keeps working. It resolves to a record holding the document ID, the sealed PDF's SHA-256 and the deletion date — and no personal data. A counterparty holding the PDF can still check their copy against that hash; the PAdES signature in their file also validates on its own, without sajn.

**Backups:** the document is gone from the live database immediately. Encrypted database backups roll off within 7 days.

post.description:
Add a party (signer/participant) to a document. The party must reference an existing contact.

**Party Roles:**
- `SIGNER` - Must sign the document
- `ORGANIZER` - Document organizer (no signature required)
- `REVIEWER` - Reviews document (no signature required)

**Per-Party Settings:**
- `deliveryMethod` - How to notify: `EMAIL` (default), `SMS`, or `NONE` (use signing URL directly)
- `requiredSignature` - Signature type: `DRAWING`, `SE_BANKID` (Swedish BankID), `CLICK_TO_SIGN`, `MANUAL`, or a national eID scheme. eID schemes are switched on market by market — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/signature-methods` for the set your account can actually use rather than hard-coding a list
- `twoStepVerification` - identity gate passed BEFORE the document opens: `NONE` (default), `PIN_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING`, or an eID gate such as `SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING` — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/two-step-verifications` for the live list

**Signing Order:** For SEQUENTIAL signing, specify the order (1, 2, 3...). For PARALLEL signing, order is ignored.

**Response:** Returns the created party, with its `signingUrl`, in the shape of `GET /api/v1/documents/:id/parties/:partyId`. sajn logs that you read the signing URL in the document's audit trail.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

contactId.description: ID of the contact to add as a signer

role.description: Party role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER.

signingOrder.description: Signing order for sequential signing (ignored for parallel)

deliveryMethod.description: How to send to this signer: EMAIL (default), SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING (default), SE_BANKID, or CLICK_TO_SIGN

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE (default), SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

documentId.description: The ID of the document the party belongs to

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

signingUrl.description: Complete signing URL for this signer

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. Stays false when the workspace requires a national ID match to sign and the attempt was refused, because no signature exists; those attempts appear only in the document audit trail.

get.description:
Retrieve all parties for a document WITHOUT signing URLs.

This endpoint returns party information for display purposes. Signing URLs are not included for security reasons.

To get a party's signing URL (which creates an audit log entry), use the GET /documents/:id/parties/:partyId endpoint.
get.summary: List all parties for a document

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

documentId.description: The ID of the document the party belongs to

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. Stays false when the workspace requires a national ID match to sign and the attempt was refused, because no signature exists; those attempts appear only in the document audit trail.

createdAt.description: When the party was added to the document

hasMore.description: Always `false`: the list returns every item in one response.

nextCursor.description: Always null: the list returns every item in one response.

patch.description:
Update party information. Most fields can only be updated before the document is sent.

After the document is sent, you can change only `name`, `email`, and `phone`, and only for a party that hasn't signed. Other parties' signatures stay valid. Replacing an email address or phone number issues a new signing link, so the old link stops working, and a party who already got the invitation through that channel gets it again. Any other property returns `409 INVALID_STATE`.

A field you leave out keeps its value. To clear `phone`, `externalId`, `nationalId`, or a key of `company`, pass `null`.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `name` - Party's full name
- `email` - Party's email address
- `phone` - Party's phone number
- `company` - The company the party signs for: `id` links a company in your workspace, and `name`, `orgNumber`, and `role` describe it. Pass `company: null` to make the party a private individual.
- `externalId` - Your external reference ID for the party
- `nationalId` - National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer, matched against the eID at signing
- `role` - Party role (SIGNER, ORGANIZER, REVIEWER)
- `signingOrder` - Order for sequential signing
- `deliveryMethod` - How to notify: `EMAIL`, `SMS`, or `NONE`
- `requiredSignature` - Signature type: `DRAWING`, `SE_BANKID` (Swedish BankID), `CLICK_TO_SIGN`, `MANUAL`, or a national eID scheme. eID schemes are switched on market by market — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/signature-methods` for the set your account can actually use rather than hard-coding a list
- `twoStepVerification` - identity gate passed BEFORE the document opens: `NONE`, `PIN_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING`, `EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING`, or an eID gate such as `SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING` — call `GET /api/v1/helpers/two-step-verifications` for the live list

**Restrictions:** Cannot update after party has signed the document.

get.description:
Retrieve a specific party including their signing URL.

**Security Note:** This endpoint creates an audit log entry each time a signing URL is accessed. Use this endpoint when you need the signing URL to share with the party.

**Response includes:**
- Party details (name, email, phone, company info)
- Signing status (NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, REJECTED)
- Read status (NOT_OPENED, OPENED, READ)
- Complete signing URL with token
get.summary: Get a party with signing URL

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: partyId
parameters.description: The party ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

documentId.description: The ID of the document the party belongs to

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

signingUrl.description: Complete signing URL for this signer

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. Stays false when the workspace requires a national ID match to sign and the attempt was refused, because no signature exists; those attempts appear only in the document audit trail.

createdAt.description: When the party was added to the document

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all contacts in your organization.

Contacts are individuals that can be added as signers to documents. Each contact can optionally be associated with a company.

**Filters:** `email`, `phone` and `externalId` match exactly. Every filter you pass must match.

**Pagination:** Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across first name, last name, email, phone, and company

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Returns only contacts whose email address equals this value exactly.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Returns only contacts whose phone number equals this value exactly. Encode a leading `+` as `%2B`.

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: Returns only the contact whose `externalId` equals this value exactly.

parameters.name: companyId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more company IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more tag IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only contacts created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only contacts created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only contacts updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only contacts updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer

externalId.description: Your external reference ID

addressLine1.description: First line of the street address

addressLine2.description: Second line of the street address, such as a c/o line

state.description: State or region of the address

country.description: Country of the address, as free text, as it was entered or imported. It isn't a country code, unlike a party's `country`.

createdAt.description: Date and time when contact was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when contact was last updated

company.description: The company the contact belongs to

country.description: Country code of the company, such as SE

createdAt.description: Date and time when the company was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the company was last updated

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Create a new contact in your organization.

**Required Fields:**
- `firstName` - Contact's first name

**Optional Fields:**
- `lastName` - Contact's last name (omit or send an empty string for single-name contacts)
- `email` - Email address
- `phone` - Phone number (for SMS notifications)
- `nationalId` - National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer, for eID verification
- `externalId` - Your external reference ID for tracking
- `companyId` - Associate with existing company
- `companyRole` - Role within the company
- `addressLine1`, `addressLine2`, `postalCode`, `city`, `state`, `country` - The contact's address

parameters.name: Sajn-Version

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

lastName.description: Contact last name (optional, e.g. for single-name contacts)

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this contact

companyId.description: ID of company to associate with

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer

addressLine1.description: First line of the street address

addressLine2.description: Second line of the street address, such as a c/o line

state.description: State or region of the address

country.description: Country of the address, as free text, such as Sverige. It isn't validated as a country code.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific contact including associated company information.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The contact ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer

externalId.description: Your external reference ID

addressLine1.description: First line of the street address

addressLine2.description: Second line of the street address, such as a c/o line

state.description: State or region of the address

country.description: Country of the address, as free text, as it was entered or imported. It isn't a country code, unlike a party's `country`.

createdAt.description: Date and time when contact was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when contact was last updated

company.description: The company the contact belongs to

country.description: Country code of the company, such as SE

createdAt.description: Date and time when the company was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the company was last updated

patch.description:
Update contact information. Omit a field to keep its value, or pass `null` to clear it.

Updating a contact doesn't change the parties of existing documents. Changes apply only to new documents.

phone.description: Contact phone number. Pass null to remove it.

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer. Pass null to remove it.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID. Pass null to remove it.

companyId.description: ID of company to associate with. Omit to keep the current company, or pass null to unlink it.

companyRole.description: Role/title within the company. Pass null to remove it.

addressLine1.description: First line of the street address

addressLine2.description: Second line of the street address, such as a c/o line

state.description: State or region of the address

country.description: Country of the address, as free text, such as Sverige. It isn't validated as a country code.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of the companies in your workspace, newest first.

Companies can be associated with contacts to track organizational relationships.

**Pagination:** Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.
**Search:** Use `query` to match part of the company name or organization number, or `orgNumber` and `name` for an exact match. Every filter you pass must match.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across company name and organization number

parameters.name: orgNumber
parameters.description: Returns only the company whose organization number equals this value. A hyphen is ignored.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Returns only companies whose name equals this value, ignoring case.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only companies created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only companies created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only companies updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only companies updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

country.description: Country code of the company, such as SE

createdAt.description: Date and time when the company was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the company was last updated

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Create a new company in your organization.

**Required Fields:**
- `name` - Company name

**Optional Fields:**
- `orgNumber` - Organization number (must be unique if provided)
- `country` - Country code, defaults to `SE`

**Note:** If a company with the same organization number exists, a 409 Conflict error is returned.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

country.description: Country code of the company, such as SE

createdAt.description: Date and time when the company was created

get.description:
Look up a company in the external company registry by organization number, including its signatories. This searches the registry, not the companies in your workspace. Results are cached for 3 days.

**Response includes:**
- Basic company info (name, status, organization number)
- Contact information (phone, address)
- Legal information (company form, domicile, registration dates)
- Tax information (VAT registration, verified against the EU VIES registry; `employer` and `fTax` aren't populated)
- Business info (SNI codes, activity description, company signature)
- Responsible persons (executives, board members, auditors, owners)
- Location coordinates

patch.description:
Changes individual boxes on a PDF field without sending the whole field. Only DRAFT documents can be changed.

Each box in `upsert` has the same shape as an entry in `fieldMeta.placedFields` on `POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields`, and is checked the same way. The response is the updated field, in the same shape as `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields/{fieldId}`. A box whose `id` already exists on the field replaces that box and keeps its stacking order. A box with a new `id` is added on top. `remove` lists the ids of boxes to delete. Boxes you don't mention stay as they are.

The change is atomic: if any box is invalid, nothing is written and the response lists every problem in `issues`. If another edit changes the field while the request runs, the request fails with an HTTP `409 Conflict` status code and code `INVALID_STATE`; send it again.

**Example - move one box and remove another:**
```json
PATCH /api/v1/documents/{docId}/fields/{fieldId}/placed-fields
{
  "upsert": [
    {
      "id": "sig-1",
      "kind": "INPUT",
      "inputType": "SIGNATURE",
      "page": 2,
      "rect": { "x": 72, "y": 120, "width": 200, "height": 48 },
      "partyId": "PARTY_ID"
    }
  ],
  "remove": ["initials-3"]
}
```

get.description:
Lists every value that the sender or a party can fill in on a document, addressed by one `key` each. The list covers FORM subfields, form fields that are part of an uploaded PDF (AcroForm fields), and input boxes placed on a PDF.

The values are in `data`. To fill in values, send the keys to `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}/field-values`.
get.summary: List the fillable values on a document

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: onlyEmpty
parameters.description: If `true`, returns only the values that are empty.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

key.description: The key you send to fill in this value. For a FORM subfield or a placed box, this is the key set in the editor, or the element ID when no key is set. For an AcroForm field, this is the field name in the PDF.

label.description: The label shown to the sender or party.

kind.description: Where the value lives: a FORM subfield, a form field that is part of the uploaded PDF, or a box placed on the PDF.

fieldId.description: The ID of the document field that holds this value. For an AcroForm field that spans several page fields, the first of them.

type.description: The input type: a FORM subfield type such as `INPUT`, `DATEPICKER`, or `CHECKBOX`, an AcroForm field type such as `TEXT` or `DROPDOWN`, or a box input type such as `DATE`.

options.description: The allowed values. A value outside this list is rejected. Null when any value is allowed.

value.description: The current value, or `null` if the value is empty. A FORM `CHECKBOX` holds a list of the selected options, and a PDF checkbox holds a boolean.

filledBy.description: If `SENDER`, you can write the value. If `SIGNER`, the party fills in the value when signing, and the value is read-only.

partyId.description: The ID of the party that fills in the value when `filledBy` is `SIGNER`.

hasMore.description: Always `false`: the list returns every item in one response.

nextCursor.description: Always null: the list returns every item in one response.

patch.description:
Fills in values by key. The same request shape works for FORM subfields, AcroForm fields, and boxes placed on a PDF. Only documents with the status DRAFT or IMPORTED can be filled in.

Keys must match exactly. To find the keys, call `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/field-values`. Set a key in the editor on a FORM subfield or a placed box, or send `key` when you create a placed box through the API, so that the key stays the same for every document created from a template.

The following example fills in a FORM subfield, a placed text box, and a PDF checkbox:

```json
{
  "values": [
    { "key": "customer-name", "value": "Example AB" },
    { "key": "org-number", "value": "556000-0000" },
    { "key": "accept-terms", "value": true }
  ]
}
```

A value fails, and the other values are still written, when its key doesn't exist, when two fields share the key, when a party fills in the value at signing, or when the value doesn't match the type or the allowed options. `results` lists the outcome for each key, with an `error` that has a `code` from the error catalogue, and `data` holds every value on the document after the write, as `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/field-values` returns them.

If another edit changes one of the fields while the request runs, nothing is written and the request fails with an HTTP `409 Conflict` status code. Send the request again.
patch.summary: Fill in values on a document

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

key.description: The `key` of a value from the field-values list.

value.description: A list of the selected options for a FORM `CHECKBOX`, a boolean for a PDF checkbox, and a string for every other type.

values.description: The values to write, at most 100 per request.

success.description: If `true`, the value was written. If `false`, `error` says why not.

error.description: Why the value was not written. Null when it was.

code.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no value has the key. `INVALID_STATE`: several fields share the key, or a party fills in the value when signing. `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the value doesn't match the type or the allowed options.

message.description: What went wrong, in English.

userMessage.description: What went wrong, in Swedish, for display to your users.

results.description: One result per input value, in request order.

remaining.description: The keys of required values with `filledBy` `SENDER` that are still empty.

key.description: The key you send to fill in this value. For a FORM subfield or a placed box, this is the key set in the editor, or the element ID when no key is set. For an AcroForm field, this is the field name in the PDF.

label.description: The label shown to the sender or party.

kind.description: Where the value lives: a FORM subfield, a form field that is part of the uploaded PDF, or a box placed on the PDF.

fieldId.description: The ID of the document field that holds this value. For an AcroForm field that spans several page fields, the first of them.

type.description: The input type: a FORM subfield type such as `INPUT`, `DATEPICKER`, or `CHECKBOX`, an AcroForm field type such as `TEXT` or `DROPDOWN`, or a box input type such as `DATE`.

options.description: The allowed values. A value outside this list is rejected. Null when any value is allowed.

value.description: The current value, or `null` if the value is empty. A FORM `CHECKBOX` holds a list of the selected options, and a PDF checkbox holds a boolean.

filledBy.description: If `SENDER`, you can write the value. If `SIGNER`, the party fills in the value when signing, and the value is read-only.

partyId.description: The ID of the party that fills in the value when `filledBy` is `SIGNER`.

data.description: Every value on the document after the write, as `GET /api/v1/documents/:id/field-values` returns them.

get.description:
Retrieve the document categories (Dokumenttyp) in the workspace, newest first.

A category scopes which custom fields apply to a document. Use an `id` from this list as `documentMeta.documentCategoryId` when creating or updating a document, or as `templateMeta.documentCategoryId` on a template.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only document categories created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only document categories created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only document categories updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only document categories updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

customFieldIds.description: Custom field IDs scoped to this category, in display order. Empty when the category scopes none.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the category was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the category was last updated

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all tags in your organization.

Tags help organize and categorize documents, templates, and contacts.

**Pagination:** Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only tags created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only tags created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only tags updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only tags updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

availableFor.description: Where this tag can be used: DOCUMENT, TEMPLATE, and/or CONTACT

createdAt.description: Date and time when tag was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when tag was last updated

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Associate a tag with a document, and return the document.

The tag's `availableFor` must include `DOCUMENT`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this document

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the document expires

status.description: Document status

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingMode.description: How the parties sign: PARALLEL, all at once, or SEQUENTIAL, one at a time in the order of each party's `signingOrder`

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

language.description: Language of the signing page and the emails to the parties, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`

value.description: The document's value, such as a contract amount, as free text. It isn't an amount of money in minor units.

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

reminderIntervalDays.description: Days between automatic reminders. `0` turns them off, and null uses the default of 3.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

deletedAt.description: Date and time when the document moved to the trash, or null when it isn't in the trash

templateId.description: ID of the template the document was created from, or null

folderId.description: ID of the folder that holds the document, or null at the top level

responsibleUserId.description: ID of the workspace member responsible for the document

parties.description: Array of document parties (signers and other participants).

documentId.description: The ID of the document the party belongs to

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. Stays false when the workspace requires a national ID match to sign and the attempt was refused, because no signature exists; those attempts appear only in the document audit trail.

createdAt.description: When the party was added to the document

fields.description: Content blocks in position order when you pass `expand=fields`, and null otherwise. See the field endpoints for the per-type shapes.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

currency.description: ISO 4217; null on tables authored before currencies

selectionPartyId.description: The party who makes the selection

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's currency, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless the table's prices include VAT.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Falls back to the table's default rate.

discount.description: Row discount, off the row amount

optional.description: The recipient may choose whether to include this row

selected.description: Whether the row counts towards the totals. Declined rows are still listed, with false.

quantity.description: Final quantity, including a recipient-set one

lineTotal.description: price × quantity − discount, in the basis the price was entered in

rows.description: Every row, selected or not, in table order

totals.description: Computed from the selected rows only. Every amount in a summary is a decimal amount in the table's currency, rounded to two decimals, not in minor units.

productTables.description: Every product table on the document, resolved: each row carries the recipient's final `selected` state and `quantity`, and the totals count the selected rows only. Empty when the document has no product table.

approvalRequestId.description: ID of the document's approval request, or null when it has none. To read it, call `GET /api/v1/approval-requests/{id}`.

documentMeta.subject: Ditt anställningsavtal från Exempelbolaget AB
documentMeta.message: Hej Kai! Här är ditt anställningsavtal. Signera det med BankID senast den 28 oktober.

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

delete.description: Remove a tag association from a document, and return the document.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: The tag ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this document

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the document expires

status.description: Document status

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingMode.description: How the parties sign: PARALLEL, all at once, or SEQUENTIAL, one at a time in the order of each party's `signingOrder`

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

language.description: Language of the signing page and the emails to the parties, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`

value.description: The document's value, such as a contract amount, as free text. It isn't an amount of money in minor units.

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

reminderIntervalDays.description: Days between automatic reminders. `0` turns them off, and null uses the default of 3.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

deletedAt.description: Date and time when the document moved to the trash, or null when it isn't in the trash

templateId.description: ID of the template the document was created from, or null

folderId.description: ID of the folder that holds the document, or null at the top level

responsibleUserId.description: ID of the workspace member responsible for the document

parties.description: Array of document parties (signers and other participants).

documentId.description: The ID of the document the party belongs to

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this signer

contactId.description: ID of the contact this party was created from, if any

nationalId.description: National identity number supplied by the sender when creating the document. Optional — BankID works without it, falling back to a name check. This is input and is never overwritten with what the eID verified: read the verified identity from GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

role.description: Signer role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

signingOrder.description: Order for sequential signing (null for parallel)

signedAt.description: Date and time when the signer signed (null if not signed)

readStatus.description: Read status: NOT_OPENED, OPENED, or READ

signingStatus.description: Signing status: NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED

deliveryMethod.description: How documents are sent to this signer: EMAIL, SMS, or NONE

requiredSignature.description: Signature type required: DRAWING, SE_BANKID, CLICK_TO_SIGN, etc.

twoStepVerification.description: Two-step verification: NONE, SMS_BEFORE_SIGNING, EMAIL_BEFORE_SIGNING, or SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING

sendStatus.description: Send status: NOT_SENT, SENT, DELIVERED, BOUNCED, or FAILED

identityVerified.description: True when an eID verified this signer — either by signing with one or by passing an eID verification gate.

identityMismatch.description: True when an eID completed, the identity did not match the intended signer, and the signature was still recorded — read GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/signatures to see what differed. Stays false when the workspace requires a national ID match to sign and the attempt was refused, because no signature exists; those attempts appear only in the document audit trail.

createdAt.description: When the party was added to the document

fields.description: Content blocks in position order when you pass `expand=fields`, and null otherwise. See the field endpoints for the per-type shapes.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

currency.description: ISO 4217; null on tables authored before currencies

selectionPartyId.description: The party who makes the selection

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's currency, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless the table's prices include VAT.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Falls back to the table's default rate.

discount.description: Row discount, off the row amount

optional.description: The recipient may choose whether to include this row

selected.description: Whether the row counts towards the totals. Declined rows are still listed, with false.

quantity.description: Final quantity, including a recipient-set one

lineTotal.description: price × quantity − discount, in the basis the price was entered in

rows.description: Every row, selected or not, in table order

totals.description: Computed from the selected rows only. Every amount in a summary is a decimal amount in the table's currency, rounded to two decimals, not in minor units.

productTables.description: Every product table on the document, resolved: each row carries the recipient's final `selected` state and `quantity`, and the totals count the selected rows only. Empty when the document has no product table.

approvalRequestId.description: ID of the document's approval request, or null when it has none. To read it, call `GET /api/v1/approval-requests/{id}`.

documentMeta.subject: Ditt anställningsavtal från Exempelbolaget AB
documentMeta.message: Hej Kai! Här är ditt anställningsavtal. Signera det med BankID senast den 28 oktober.

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

get.description:
List a document's links to other documents, in both directions.

**Link types:** AMENDS, REPLACES, RENEWS, RELATES_TO — the from-document acts on the to-document.

**Direction:** FROM means this document is the acting end of the link; TO means another document links to it.

Links whose other end you don't have access to are omitted. A trashed target is returned with `target: null`.

post.description:
Create a link from this document to another document in the same organization.

**Required Fields:**
- `toDocumentId` - The document to link to
- `linkType` - AMENDS, REPLACES, RENEWS or RELATES_TO (this document acts on the target)

Both documents must be accessible to the acting user. RELATES_TO is symmetric — the same pair can only be related once regardless of direction.

**Response:** Returns the link in the shape of an item from `GET /api/v1/documents/:id/links`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

toDocumentId.description: The document to link to (the older/passive end)

linkType.description: How this document relates to the target

fromDocumentId.description: ID of the document that acts on the other one. For `RELATES_TO`, which has no direction, either end.

toDocumentId.description: ID of the document the from-document acts on

linkType.description: How the documents relate: the from-document AMENDS/REPLACES/RENEWS/RELATES_TO the to-document

direction.description: Which end of the link this document is — FROM means this document is the acting/newer one

origin.description: How the link was created: `MANUAL`, `DUPLICATE`, or `RENEWAL`

createdAt.description: When the link was created

target.description: The other end of the link; null when that document has been moved to trash

status.description: The other document's status

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of custom field definitions.

Custom fields allow you to add additional structured data to documents or contacts.

Filter by `type` (DOCUMENT or CONTACT). The newest custom fields come first.

**Pagination:** Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Returns only custom fields of this type.

parameters.name: createdAfter

post.description:
Create a new custom field definition.

**Required Fields:**
- `name` - Field name
- `type` - DOCUMENT or CONTACT
- `inputType` - Input type (TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, BOOLEAN, SELECT, TEXTAREA, EMAIL, PHONE, URL, JSON)

**Optional Fields:**
- `defaultValue` - Default value for the field
- `required` - Whether field is required (default: false)
- `options` - For SELECT type, the options as an array of strings, for example `["Small","Large"]`

parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

inputType.description: Input type (required): TEXT, NUMBER, DATE, CHECKBOX, SELECT, TEXTAREA, EMAIL, PHONE, or URL

required.description: Whether this field is required (default: false)

options.description: The options of a SELECT field, for example `["Small","Large"]`. Required for SELECT.

get.description:
Lists the sajn ID identity checks in your workspace, newest first. An identity check asks a person to verify who they are with BankID, matched against their national identity number or, without one, their name.

Filter by `status`, `createdAfter` and `createdBefore`. Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status. Comma-separated or repeated.

items.description:
sajn ID Status:
- CREATED: Verification created but not sent
- SENT: Verification sent to recipient
- OPENED: Recipient opened verification link
- VERIFIED: Identity successfully verified
- FAILED: Verification failed
- EXPIRED: Verification link expired
- CANCELLED: Verification was cancelled

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only checks created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only checks created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only checks updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only checks updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

fullName.description: Full name of the person to verify.

email.description: Email address the link goes to on the `EMAIL` channel.

phone.description: Phone number the link goes to on the `SMS` channel.

channel.description: How the recipient got the verification link.

status.description:
sajn ID Status:
- CREATED: Verification created but not sent
- SENT: Verification sent to recipient
- OPENED: Recipient opened verification link
- VERIFIED: Identity successfully verified
- FAILED: Verification failed
- EXPIRED: Verification link expired
- CANCELLED: Verification was cancelled

reference.description: Your own reference for the check.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, such as `sv` or `en`. `GET /api/v1/helpers/languages` lists them.

expiresAt.description: When the identity check and its link expire.

verifiedAt.description: When the person was verified. Null until then.

createdAt.description: When the identity check was created.

updatedAt.description: When the identity check was last updated.

verificationUrl.description: The verification link. Set only in the response to the create request; null otherwise.

contact.description: The contact the check is linked to.

createdBy.description: A sajn user

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

audits.description: What happened to the check, newest first. Null in lists and in the response to the create request.

createdAt.description: When this event occurred

name.description: Name of person who triggered this event

email.description: Email of person who triggered this event

data.description: Verification data, such as the BankID result. Null in lists and in the response to the create request.

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Creates an identity check and sends its link to the person over `channel`: `EMAIL` needs `email` and `SMS` needs `phone`.

With `nationalId`, BankID verifies that the person's national identity number matches it. Without it, BankID verifies that their name matches `fullName`.

The response is the only one that includes `verificationUrl` and `token`. Each check counts toward your monthly identity check quota.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

fullName.description: Full name of the person to verify (required)

email.description: Email address to send the link to. Required on the `EMAIL` channel.

phone.description: Phone number to send the link to. Required on the `SMS` channel.

channel.description: How the recipient gets the verification link: `EMAIL` or `SMS`.

contactId.description: Optional contact ID to link this verification to

expiresAt.description: When the identity check and its link expire. Must be in the future. Default: 7 days after creation.

language.description: Language of the verification messages. Default: `sv`.

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer. When set, BankID verifies that it matches; otherwise BankID verifies the name.

fullName.description: Full name of the person to verify.

email.description: Email address the link goes to on the `EMAIL` channel.

phone.description: Phone number the link goes to on the `SMS` channel.

channel.description: How the recipient got the verification link.

- CREATED: Verification created but not sent
- SENT: Verification sent to recipient
- OPENED: Recipient opened verification link
- VERIFIED: Identity successfully verified
- FAILED: Verification failed
- EXPIRED: Verification link expired
- CANCELLED: Verification was cancelled

get.description: Returns one identity check, with its audit log and verification data, such as the BankID result. The national identity number is encrypted and never returned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The identity check ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

fullName.description: Full name of the person to verify.

email.description: Email address the link goes to on the `EMAIL` channel.

phone.description: Phone number the link goes to on the `SMS` channel.

channel.description: How the recipient got the verification link.

status.description:
sajn ID Status:
- CREATED: Verification created but not sent
- SENT: Verification sent to recipient
- OPENED: Recipient opened verification link
- VERIFIED: Identity successfully verified
- FAILED: Verification failed
- EXPIRED: Verification link expired
- CANCELLED: Verification was cancelled

reference.description: Your own reference for the check.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, such as `sv` or `en`. `GET /api/v1/helpers/languages` lists them.

expiresAt.description: When the identity check and its link expire.

verifiedAt.description: When the person was verified. Null until then.

createdAt.description: When the identity check was created.

updatedAt.description: When the identity check was last updated.

verificationUrl.description: The verification link. Set only in the response to the create request; null otherwise.

contact.description: The contact the check is linked to.

createdBy.description: A sajn user

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

audits.description: What happened to the check, newest first. Null in lists and in the response to the create request.

createdAt.description: When this event occurred

name.description: Name of person who triggered this event

email.description: Email of person who triggered this event

data.description: Verification data, such as the BankID result. Null in lists and in the response to the create request.

audits.name: Kai Lindqvist
audits.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 14_6) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/18.0 Safari/605.1.15

get.description:
Retrieve file information and access URL.

**URL Generation:**
- For `PRIVATE` files: Returns a fresh signed URL (valid for 15 minutes)
- For `PUBLIC` files: Returns the permanent CloudFront URL

**Response includes:**
- File metadata (filename, size, MIME type)
- Visibility setting
- Access URL
- Upload information

**Warning:** This operation is irreversible. The file is permanently deleted from both storage and the database.

post.description:
Create a file record and get a presigned URL to upload the bytes **directly to storage**.

**Flow:**
1. Compute the file's SHA-256 hash and base64-encode it.
2. Call this endpoint with the filename, MIME type, size, and checksum. You receive the file object and a presigned `uploadUrl`.
3. `PUT` the raw bytes to `uploadUrl` with headers `Content-Type: <mimeType>` and `x-amz-checksum-sha256: <checksum>`. S3 verifies the checksum on write.
4. (Recommended) Call `POST /api/v1/files/:id/confirm` to verify the upload and flip the record to `CONFIRMED` immediately. Otherwise it is confirmed automatically the first time it is fetched via `GET /api/v1/files/:id`.

**Why:** the bytes go straight to storage, so there is no API-server size limit.

parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

checksum.description: Base64-encoded SHA-256 checksum of the file. S3 enforces it on upload, so a mismatch rejects the bytes.

visibility.description: File visibility (default PRIVATE)

schema.description: Request a presigned upload URL and create a pending file record

200.description: The created file and the URL to upload its bytes to

visibility.description: File visibility

url.description: URL to access the file (signed URL for private, direct URL for public)

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

uploadedBy.description: The user who uploaded the file

key.description: The storage key of the file. Set it as a PDF field's `fieldMeta.value` to render the file.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL (valid 15 minutes). Upload the bytes here with headers Content-Type: <mimeType> and x-amz-checksum-sha256: <checksum>.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of files in your organization.

**Pagination:** Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.

**Filtering:** Optionally filter by visibility (PRIVATE or PUBLIC).

**Response:**
- Files are sorted by creation date (newest first)
- Use the 'getFile' endpoint to retrieve file access URLs

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Filter by visibility

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only files created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only files created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only files updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only files updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Paginated list of files

visibility.description: File visibility

createdAt.description: Date and time when file was uploaded

updatedAt.description: Date and time when file was last updated

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

uploadedBy.description: The user who uploaded the file

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Confirm a previously-created file after its bytes have been uploaded to the presigned URL.

The server reads the persisted object back from storage (`HeadObject`), verifies the size and — when the backend records it — that the SHA-256 matches the checksum supplied at create time, then flips the file from `PENDING` to `CONFIRMED`.

**When to call:** right after the upload `PUT` returns `200`. It is optional but recommended — a file is otherwise confirmed lazily the first time it is fetched via `GET /api/v1/files/:id`. Idempotent: confirming an already-confirmed file returns it unchanged.

**Response:** Returns the file in the shape of `GET /api/v1/files/:id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The file ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

200.description: File information with access URL

visibility.description: File visibility

url.description: URL to access the file (signed URL for private, direct URL for public)

createdAt.description: Date and time when file was uploaded

updatedAt.description: Date and time when file was last updated

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

uploadedBy.description: The user who uploaded the file

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all webhooks in your organization.

Webhooks allow you to receive real-time notifications when events occur in your workspace (e.g., document signed, contact created).

**Pagination:** Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only webhooks created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only webhooks created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only webhooks updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only webhooks updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.
