post.description:
Create a new webhook subscription for your workspace.

**Required Fields:**
- `url` - URL that receives a POST request for each event
- `events` - The event types to subscribe to, such as `document.completed`

**Optional Fields:**
- `secret` - Signing secret in the Standard Webhooks format, `whsec_<base64>`. sajn generates one when omitted, and the response returns it once
- `enabled` - Whether the webhook is active (default: true)
- `apiVersion` - API version, such as `2026-10`, that determines the body this endpoint receives. Defaults to your organization's API version. The endpoint keeps this version until you change it with `PATCH /api/v1/webhooks/:id`

**Delivery:** each event is a POST with the body `{ id, type, createdAt, apiVersion, workspaceId, environment, actor, data }`, the same object `GET /api/v1/events/:id` returns. `data.object` is the resource the event is about. The request follows [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com): `webhook-id` is the event `id`, `webhook-timestamp` is the send time in Unix seconds, and `webhook-signature` is `v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>` over `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw body>`, keyed with the base64-decoded secret after `whsec_`. Any Standard Webhooks library verifies it. Return a 2xx status code within 30 seconds. sajn retries any other answer, a timeout, and a network error with backoff for about three days, and stops at once on `410 Gone`. Delivery is at least once, so deduplicate on `webhook-id`.

**Event types:** `events` takes the following values:
- Document, with the document in `data.object`: `document.created` (with `data.source`), `document.sent`, `document.fully_signed`, `document.completed`, `document.rejected`, `document.expired`, `document.withdrawn`, `document.updated`, `document.deleted`, `document.restored`, `document.archived`, `document.unarchived`, `document.expiration_extended`, `document.expiring_soon`, and `document.comment.created`, with the comment in `data.object`
- Party, with the document in `data.object` and the party in `data.party`: `document.party.sent`, `document.party.delivery_failed`, `document.party.opened`, `document.party.read`, `document.party.signed`, `document.party.rejected`, `document.party.delegated`, `document.party.auth_failed`, `document.party.verified`, `document.party.updated`, `document.party.added`, `document.party.removed`, `document.party.reminded`
- Approval: `approval_request.created`, `approval_request.approved`, `approval_request.rejected`, `approval_request.cancelled`
- Identity check: `identity_check.created`, `identity_check.sent`, `identity_check.opened`, `identity_check.verified`, `identity_check.failed`, `identity_check.cancelled`
- Contact, company and template: `contact.created`, `contact.updated`, `contact.deleted`, `company.created`, `company.updated`, `company.deleted`, `template.created`, `template.updated`, `template.deleted`, `template.restored`
- Form: `form.submitted`, with the same fields as `GET /api/v1/forms/:id/submissions/:submissionId`
- Workspace: `workspace.created`, `member.added`, `member.invited`, `member.invite_accepted`
- sajn Login: `login.completed`, `login.failed`, with the login session in `data.object`
- Security, a feed for a SIEM: `security.document_downloaded`, `security.documents_exported`, `security.signature_identity_accessed`, `security.member_removed`, `security.member_role_changed`, `security.role_updated`, `security.workspace_retention_updated`
- Usage: `usage.limit_reached`

**Plan Requirement:** Requires the Team plan or higher, or a sandbox organization.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific webhook including the event types it subscribes to. The response leaves out `secret`, which only creating the webhook and rotating its secret return.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Webhook response

secret.description: Signing secret for this endpoint, in the Standard Webhooks format `whsec_<base64>`. Returned only when you create the webhook and when you rotate the secret, so store it then.

status.description: `DISABLED` when `enabled` is false. `PAUSED` when sajn stopped delivering because the endpoint failed for three days or answered `410 Gone`; resume with `POST /api/v1/webhooks/:id/reactivate`.

pausedAt.description: When sajn paused the webhook. Null unless `status` is `PAUSED`.

pauseReason.description: Why sajn paused the webhook: `HTTP_<status code>` for the last answer, such as `HTTP_410`, or `NETWORK_ERROR`. Null unless `status` is `PAUSED`.

failureNotificationEmail.description: Email address that receives a notification if webhook delivery fails

events.description: The event types this webhook subscribes to

apiVersion.description: API version, in YYYY-MM format, that determines the payload shape this endpoint receives

createdAt.description: Date and time when webhook was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when webhook was last updated

patch.description:
Update webhook properties. Every field is optional, and an omitted field keeps its value.

To move the endpoint to a newer payload shape, set `apiVersion`. Every delivery after the change uses the new version, including retries of earlier events.

To replace the signing secret, use `POST /api/v1/webhooks/:id/rotate-secret`.

**Plan Requirement:** Requires the Team plan or higher, or a sandbox organization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

url.description: URL that will receive webhook events

events.description: The event types to subscribe to. Replaces the current list

failureNotificationEmail.description: Email address that will be notified if webhook delivery fails

apiVersion.description: API version that determines the payload shape this endpoint receives. Set it to upgrade the endpoint to a newer payload shape

200.description: Webhook response

secret.description: Signing secret for this endpoint, in the Standard Webhooks format `whsec_<base64>`. Returned only when you create the webhook and when you rotate the secret, so store it then.

status.description: `DISABLED` when `enabled` is false. `PAUSED` when sajn stopped delivering because the endpoint failed for three days or answered `410 Gone`; resume with `POST /api/v1/webhooks/:id/reactivate`.

pausedAt.description: When sajn paused the webhook. Null unless `status` is `PAUSED`.

pauseReason.description: Why sajn paused the webhook: `HTTP_<status code>` for the last answer, such as `HTTP_410`, or `NETWORK_ERROR`. Null unless `status` is `PAUSED`.

failureNotificationEmail.description: Email address that receives a notification if webhook delivery fails

events.description: The event types this webhook subscribes to

apiVersion.description: API version, in YYYY-MM format, that determines the payload shape this endpoint receives

createdAt.description: Date and time when webhook was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when webhook was last updated

post.description:
Generates a new signing secret and returns the webhook with it in `secret`. Store it: no other response returns it.

For 24 hours, every delivery carries two signatures in `webhook-signature`, one per secret, so you can deploy the new secret without dropping deliveries. A Standard Webhooks library accepts a request when any signature matches. After 24 hours, only the new secret signs.

**Plan Requirement:** Requires the Team plan or higher, or a sandbox organization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

200.description: Webhook response

secret.description: Signing secret for this endpoint, in the Standard Webhooks format `whsec_<base64>`. Returned only when you create the webhook and when you rotate the secret, so store it then.

status.description: `DISABLED` when `enabled` is false. `PAUSED` when sajn stopped delivering because the endpoint failed for three days or answered `410 Gone`; resume with `POST /api/v1/webhooks/:id/reactivate`.

pausedAt.description: When sajn paused the webhook. Null unless `status` is `PAUSED`.

pauseReason.description: Why sajn paused the webhook: `HTTP_<status code>` for the last answer, such as `HTTP_410`, or `NETWORK_ERROR`. Null unless `status` is `PAUSED`.

failureNotificationEmail.description: Email address that receives a notification if webhook delivery fails

events.description: The event types this webhook subscribes to

apiVersion.description: API version, in YYYY-MM format, that determines the payload shape this endpoint receives

createdAt.description: Date and time when webhook was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when webhook was last updated

post.description:
Resumes deliveries to a webhook that sajn paused, and returns the webhook with `status: ENABLED`. sajn pauses a webhook when every delivery attempt failed for three days, or when the endpoint answered `410 Gone`. Events from the pause are kept as failed deliveries; to send one, retry it with `POST /api/v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId/retry`.

Returns `409 INVALID_STATE` when the webhook isn't paused, or is disabled. To turn on a disabled webhook, set `enabled` with `PATCH /api/v1/webhooks/:id`.

**Plan Requirement:** Requires the Team plan or higher, or a sandbox organization.

post.description:
Sends a `webhook.test` event to this webhook only, signed and delivered like any other event in the webhook's API version, and returns the delivery with `status: PENDING`. `data.object` is the webhook's `id` and `url`. Follow the delivery with `GET /api/v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId`. The event isn't listed in `GET /api/v1/events`, and no other webhook receives it.

Returns `409 INVALID_STATE` when the webhook is disabled or paused.

**Plan Requirement:** Requires the Team plan or higher, or a sandbox organization.
post.summary: Send a test event to a webhook

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

id.description: ID of the delivery: one event sent to one endpoint, with every attempt to send it.

eventId.description: ID of the event, as `GET /api/v1/events/:id` takes it. Null for a delivery made before sajn recorded it.

type.description: The event type, such as `document.completed`. Null for an event type that 2026-10 no longer has.

status.description: `SUCCESS` when an attempt got a 2xx answer, `FAILED` when sajn stopped retrying, and `PENDING` while attempts remain.

url.description: The endpoint URL the delivery was sent to.

replayOfId.description: ID of the delivery this one replays. Null for an original delivery.

requestBody.description: The JSON body sent to the endpoint, in the webhook's API version. Null until the first attempt.

post.description:
Submits a `DRAFT` document for internal approval. The document's status changes to `PENDING_APPROVAL`, and sajn notifies the approvers of the first stage. When the request is approved, sajn sends the document for signing, unless approvers already on the document were set up with `autoSend` false.

Pass `approverIds` to set who approves; every one of them must approve. Omit it to submit the approvers already on the document, such as the ones its template adds. A template that locks its approvers returns `409 INVALID_STATE` if you pass `approverIds`.

To resubmit a rejected request, call this endpoint again. The request keeps its ID, and every approver's decision is reset, so earlier decisions aren't kept. The resubmission fires `approval_request.created` again, with the same `data.object.id`.

**Permission required:** `SEND_DOCUMENT` on the workspace.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

approverIds.description: User IDs of the approvers. Every one of them must approve, in any order. Omit it to submit the approvers already on the document, such as the ones its template adds. To list members who can approve, call `GET /api/v1/members?permission=APPROVE_DOCUMENT`.

customMessage.description: Message to include in the signing invitation when the approved document is sent. Requires `approverIds`.

schema.description: Request internal approval of a document

200.description: An internal approval request for a document

status.description: `DRAFT` while the document is a draft and the request isn't submitted, such as approvers a template added or a request whose document was withdrawn; `PENDING` while it waits for approvers; `APPROVED` once every stage approves; `REJECTED` after any approver rejects; `CANCELLED` only in the response to the cancel request and in the `approval_request.cancelled` event, because a cancelled request is deleted.

autoSend.description: If true, sajn sends the document for signing when the request is approved. If false, the document waits for you to send it.

customMessage.description: The message included in the signing invitation when the document is sent

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

requestedBy.description: The user who submitted the request

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

stage.description: Stages run in ascending order. Approvers in the same stage approve in parallel.

orGroup.description: Approvers in the same stage with the same `orGroup` need only one approval between them. Null when this approver's approval is required.

status.description: This approver's decision

createdAt.description: When the approval was created.

updatedAt.description: When the approval was last updated.

get.description: Lists the approval requests on documents you can read, newest first. A document has at most one request. To find the requests waiting for someone, pass `approverId` and `status=PENDING`; the result also lists requests whose turn for that approver hasn't come yet in a later stage.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: Only requests for these documents. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: approverId
parameters.description: Only requests where one of these users is an approver. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only requests with one of these statuses. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Approval requests, newest first

status.description: `DRAFT` while the document is a draft and the request isn't submitted, such as approvers a template added or a request whose document was withdrawn; `PENDING` while it waits for approvers; `APPROVED` once every stage approves; `REJECTED` after any approver rejects; `CANCELLED` only in the response to the cancel request and in the `approval_request.cancelled` event, because a cancelled request is deleted.

autoSend.description: If true, sajn sends the document for signing when the request is approved. If false, the document waits for you to send it.

customMessage.description: The message included in the signing invitation when the document is sent

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

requestedBy.description: The user who submitted the request

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

stage.description: Stages run in ascending order. Approvers in the same stage approve in parallel.

orGroup.description: Approvers in the same stage with the same `orGroup` need only one approval between them. Null when this approver's approval is required.

status.description: This approver's decision

createdAt.description: When the approval was created.

updatedAt.description: When the approval was last updated.

items.description: An internal approval request for a document

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Approves the request as the authenticated user, who must be an approver in the current stage. You can't approve on someone else's behalf. When the last required approver approves, the request becomes `APPROVED`, and with `autoSend` set to true, sajn sends the document for signing.

**Permission required:** `APPROVE_DOCUMENT` on the workspace.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The approval ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

200.description: An internal approval request for a document

status.description: `DRAFT` while the document is a draft and the request isn't submitted, such as approvers a template added or a request whose document was withdrawn; `PENDING` while it waits for approvers; `APPROVED` once every stage approves; `REJECTED` after any approver rejects; `CANCELLED` only in the response to the cancel request and in the `approval_request.cancelled` event, because a cancelled request is deleted.

autoSend.description: If true, sajn sends the document for signing when the request is approved. If false, the document waits for you to send it.

customMessage.description: The message included in the signing invitation when the document is sent

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

requestedBy.description: The user who submitted the request

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

stage.description: Stages run in ascending order. Approvers in the same stage approve in parallel.

orGroup.description: Approvers in the same stage with the same `orGroup` need only one approval between them. Null when this approver's approval is required.

status.description: This approver's decision

createdAt.description: When the approval was created.

updatedAt.description: When the approval was last updated.

schema.description: An internal approval request for a document

example.customMessage: Påminnelse: signera ditt anställningsavtal senast den 28 oktober.

post.description:
Cancels a `PENDING` request. Only the user who submitted it can cancel it. sajn deletes the request, so the response is the last state of the request with `status` set to `CANCELLED`, and `GET /api/v1/approval-requests/{id}` returns `404` afterwards. The `approval_request.cancelled` event carries the same last state, so it's the only record of the request. The document returns to `DRAFT`.

**Permission required:** `SEND_DOCUMENT` on the workspace.

get.description:
Retrieve a paginated list of all templates in your workspace.

Templates let you predefine document structure, fields, and default parties, then spawn documents from them via `POST /api/v1/documents` with `templateId`.

**Pagination:** Pass `nextCursor` from the previous response as `cursor` until `hasMore` is false.
**Search:** Use `query` to filter by template name.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search template names (partial match)

parameters.name: tagId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more tag IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Filter by folder ID. Pass `root` to include only top-level templates.

parameters.name: createdById
parameters.description: Filter by creator user IDs. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: private
parameters.description: If `true`, returns only private templates. If `false`, returns only public ones.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only templates created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only templates created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only templates updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only templates updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Paginated list of templates

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID this template belongs to

organizationId.description: Organization ID this template belongs to

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

createdBy.description: The user who created the template

isGlobal.description: Whether this is a global template

templateMeta.description: The settings that documents created from the template start with

signingMode.description: If `PARALLEL`, every party can sign at once. If `SEQUENTIAL`, the parties sign one at a time, in `signingOrder`.

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

language.description: Language of the signing page and the emails to the parties, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`

value.description: The document's value, such as a contract amount, as free text. It isn't an amount of money in minor units.

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether documents created from this template remain signable after expiration

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML)

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

reminderIntervalDays.description: Days between automatic reminders. `0` turns them off, and null uses the default of 3.

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once a document created from this template is completed

visibility.description: Who can see documents created from this template: EVERYONE, RESPONSIBLE, PERMISSION, or USER_SPECIFIC

selectedUserIds.description: User IDs granted access when visibility is USER_SPECIFIC

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) applied to documents created from this template. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

templateId.description: Template ID this party belongs to

role.description: Party role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

contactId.description: Linked contact ID

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: External reference ID

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

requiredSignature.description: Default required signature type

deliveryMethod.description: Default delivery method

twoStepVerification.description: Default two-step verification

createdAt.description: When the party was added to the template

updatedAt.description: When the party was last changed

parties.description: The default parties that documents created from the template start with

fields.description: The content blocks in position order. Null unless you pass `expand=fields` to `GET /api/v1/templates/:id`.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the template was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the template was last updated

deletedAt.description: Date and time when the template was moved to the trash. Null unless the response is to `DELETE /api/v1/templates/:id`.

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

post.description:
Create a new template in your workspace.

**Required Fields:**
- `name` - Template name

**Optional Fields:**
- `initialFields` - Array of fields to create with the template. Each field has `type`, `position`, and `fieldMeta`.

**Usage:** After creating a template, add default parties via `POST /api/v1/templates/:id/parties` and tags via `POST /api/v1/templates/:id/tags`. Then create documents from it using `POST /api/v1/documents` with `templateId`.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

initialFields.description: Initial fields to create with the template

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

organizationId.description: Organization ID this template belongs to

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

createdBy.description: The user who created the template

isGlobal.description: Whether this is a global template

templateMeta.description: The settings that documents created from the template start with

signingMode.description: If `PARALLEL`, every party can sign at once. If `SEQUENTIAL`, the parties sign one at a time, in `signingOrder`.

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once a document created from this template is completed

visibility.description: Who can see documents created from this template: EVERYONE, RESPONSIBLE, PERMISSION, or USER_SPECIFIC

selectedUserIds.description: User IDs granted access when visibility is USER_SPECIFIC

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

templateId.description: Template ID this party belongs to

role.description: Party role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

contactId.description: Linked contact ID

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: External reference ID

requiredSignature.description: Default required signature type

deliveryMethod.description: Default delivery method

twoStepVerification.description: Default two-step verification

updatedAt.description: When the party was last changed

patch.description:
Update template properties.

**Updatable Fields:**
- `name` - Template name
- `templateMeta` - Default settings for documents created from this template, such as `signingMode` and `language`

The response is the template, in the same shape as `GET /api/v1/templates/:id`. A locked template can't be updated: the request fails with an HTTP `409 Conflict` status code and the code `INVALID_STATE`.

parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

delete.description: Moves a template to the trash, where it's deleted permanently after 90 days. Documents already created from the template don't change. The response is the template with `deletedAt` set. A locked template can't be deleted: the request fails with an HTTP `409 Conflict` status code and the code `INVALID_STATE`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID this template belongs to

organizationId.description: Organization ID this template belongs to

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

createdBy.description: The user who created the template

isGlobal.description: Whether this is a global template

templateMeta.description: The settings that documents created from the template start with

signingMode.description: If `PARALLEL`, every party can sign at once. If `SEQUENTIAL`, the parties sign one at a time, in `signingOrder`.

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

language.description: Language of the signing page and the emails to the parties, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`

value.description: The document's value, such as a contract amount, as free text. It isn't an amount of money in minor units.

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether documents created from this template remain signable after expiration

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML)

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

reminderIntervalDays.description: Days between automatic reminders. `0` turns them off, and null uses the default of 3.

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once a document created from this template is completed

visibility.description: Who can see documents created from this template: EVERYONE, RESPONSIBLE, PERMISSION, or USER_SPECIFIC

selectedUserIds.description: User IDs granted access when visibility is USER_SPECIFIC

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) applied to documents created from this template. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

templateId.description: Template ID this party belongs to

role.description: Party role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

contactId.description: Linked contact ID

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: External reference ID

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

requiredSignature.description: Default required signature type

deliveryMethod.description: Default delivery method

twoStepVerification.description: Default two-step verification

createdAt.description: When the party was added to the template

updatedAt.description: When the party was last changed

parties.description: The default parties that documents created from the template start with

fields.description: The content blocks in position order. Null unless you pass `expand=fields` to `GET /api/v1/templates/:id`.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the template was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the template was last updated

deletedAt.description: Date and time when the template was moved to the trash. Null unless the response is to `DELETE /api/v1/templates/:id`.

post.description: Creates a copy of a template, with its fields and parties. The response is the copy, in the same shape as `GET /api/v1/templates/:id`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID this template belongs to

organizationId.description: Organization ID this template belongs to

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

createdBy.description: The user who created the template

isGlobal.description: Whether this is a global template

templateMeta.description: The settings that documents created from the template start with

signingMode.description: If `PARALLEL`, every party can sign at once. If `SEQUENTIAL`, the parties sign one at a time, in `signingOrder`.

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

language.description: Language of the signing page and the emails to the parties, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`

value.description: The document's value, such as a contract amount, as free text. It isn't an amount of money in minor units.

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether documents created from this template remain signable after expiration

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML)

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

reminderIntervalDays.description: Days between automatic reminders. `0` turns them off, and null uses the default of 3.

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once a document created from this template is completed

visibility.description: Who can see documents created from this template: EVERYONE, RESPONSIBLE, PERMISSION, or USER_SPECIFIC

selectedUserIds.description: User IDs granted access when visibility is USER_SPECIFIC

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) applied to documents created from this template. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

templateId.description: Template ID this party belongs to

role.description: Party role: SIGNER, ORGANIZER, or REVIEWER

contactId.description: Linked contact ID

company.description: The company the party signs for, or null for a private individual

id.description: ID of the linked company in your workspace

role.description: The party's role or title at the company

externalId.description: External reference ID

nationalId.description: National identity number, such as a Swedish personnummer

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the party, such as SE

requiredSignature.description: Default required signature type

deliveryMethod.description: Default delivery method

twoStepVerification.description: Default two-step verification

createdAt.description: When the party was added to the template

updatedAt.description: When the party was last changed

parties.description: The default parties that documents created from the template start with

fields.description: The content blocks in position order. Null unless you pass `expand=fields` to `GET /api/v1/templates/:id`.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the template was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the template was last updated

deletedAt.description: Date and time when the template was moved to the trash. Null unless the response is to `DELETE /api/v1/templates/:id`.

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

parameters.description: The field ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

patch.description: Updates a template field by its ID, the same way as `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields/{fieldId}`. The response is the updated field.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: fieldId
parameters.description: The field ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the content blocks

fieldMeta.description: The full metadata for the field type. It replaces the stored metadata.

pageWidth.description: Width of the page in PDF points, the unit `rect` is measured in. Omit to use the width of the PDF page.

pageHeight.description: Height of the page in PDF points. Omit to use the height of the PDF page.

pageRotation.description: Rotation of the page in degrees. Omit to use the rotation of the PDF page.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

patch.description: Changes individual boxes on a template PDF field, the same way as `PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}/fields/{fieldId}/placed-fields`, with `partyId` referring to a template party. The response is the updated field.
patch.summary: Add, update, or remove boxes on a template PDF field

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: fieldId
parameters.description: The field ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

upsert.description: Boxes to add or replace. A box whose `id` already exists on the field replaces that box and keeps its stacking order; any other box is added on top.

pageWidth.description: Width of the page in PDF points, the unit `rect` is measured in. Omit to use the width of the PDF page.

pageHeight.description: Height of the page in PDF points. Omit to use the height of the PDF page.

pageRotation.description: Rotation of the page in degrees. Omit to use the rotation of the PDF page.

items.description: A box placed on a page of a PDF field

remove.description: Ids of boxes to remove from the field.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

post.description:
Add a default party/signer to a template. You can either reference an existing contact via `contactId`, or provide `name` with optional email/phone/company details manually.

These parties are inherited as signers when a document is created from this template (unless overridden).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version

get.description: Returns the organization's plan, its quotas, what it used this billing month, and what remains: documents, eID signatures per scheme (`signatures`, keyed by a scheme such as `SE_BANKID`), members, the AI budget, identity checks, and workspaces. An unlimited quota is `null`. Money is `{ amount, currency }` in minor units: `balance` is in the organization's currency, and the AI budget is in `SEK`. Use it to gate features, such as checking how many BankID signatures remain before you send.

get.description: Returns the workspaces in the authenticated user's organization that they are a member of. The workspace bound to the current API token is marked with `isCurrent: true`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Workspaces accessible to the authenticated user

createdAt.description: When the workspace was created.

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

schema.description: Workspaces accessible to the authenticated user

post.description:
Adds a member of the organization to this workspace with the role `roleId`, and returns the new member. To list roles, call `GET /api/v1/roles`.

If the email address is on a domain that your organization manages through SSO, and no account has it yet, the request creates the account, makes it a member of the organization and this workspace, and returns it. The person signs in through SSO, so there's no invitation to accept.

Otherwise, if no member of the organization has the email address, the request returns `404`. To invite someone who isn't a member of the organization yet, call `POST /api/v1/member-invites`.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_MEMBERS` on the workspace.

get.description:
Returns the members of the workspace bound to the current API token, paginated and filterable by activity, role, permission and free-text search. To list the members who can approve documents, pass `permission=APPROVE_DOCUMENT`. Address an individual member by their `id`, which is their user ID.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_MEMBERS` on the workspace.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by activity. A member is `ACTIVE` once they have signed in at least once. Omit for both.

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: Only return members with one of these workspace roles. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: permission
parameters.description: Only return members whose role grants this permission, directly or through `ADMINISTRATOR`. For example, `APPROVE_DOCUMENT` lists the members who can approve documents.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across member name and email

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Default: `joinedAt`.

parameters.name: orderDirection
parameters.description: The sort direction. Default: `desc`.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Paginated workspace members

id.description: User ID of the member. Address the member with it in `/api/v1/members/{userId}`.

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

role.description: Workspace role

status.description: `ACTIVE` once the member has signed in at least once

joinedAt.description: When the user was added to the workspace

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Invites someone who isn't a member of the organization to join it and this workspace with the role `roleId`, and emails them the invitation. The invitation expires after two days; to send it again, call `POST /api/v1/member-invites/{id}/resend`. When they accept, they become a member of the workspace.

To add someone who is already a member of the organization, or whose email address is on a domain that your organization manages through SSO, call `POST /api/v1/members`. If the email address already has a pending invitation, the request returns `409 ALREADY_EXISTS`, and if it's on an SSO-managed domain, `409 INVALID_STATE`.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_MEMBERS` on the workspace.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite. They must not be a member of the organization.

roleId.description: Workspace role ID the invitee gets on accepting. To list roles, call `GET /api/v1/roles`.

200.description: An invitation to join the workspace

role.description: The workspace role the invitee gets on accepting

status.description: `PENDING` until the invitee accepts, then `ACCEPTED`

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

invitedBy.description: The member who sent the invitation

createdAt.description: When the invitation was created.

schema.description: An invitation to join the workspace

get.description:
Lists the roles of the workspace bound to the current API token, with the permission keys each role grants and how many members hold it. Pass a role's `id` as `roleId` when you add or update a member or create an invitation; role names can change.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_ROLES` on the workspace.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: Workspace roles available on the current workspace

id.description: Role ID. Pass it as `roleId` when you add or update a member; role names can change.

name.description: Role name. Organization administrators can rename it.

isDefault.description: True for a built-in role, which you can't edit or delete

items.description: A workspace permission key, e.g. "READ_DOCUMENT" or "SEND_DOCUMENT"

permissions.description: Permission keys granted by this role

memberCount.description: Number of workspace members currently assigned this role

createdAt.description: When the workspace role was created.

updatedAt.description: When the workspace role was last updated.

hasMore.description: Always `false`: the list returns every item in one response.

nextCursor.description: Always null: the list returns every item in one response.

get.description:
Gets a role, with its permission keys and member count.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_ROLES` on the workspace.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The workspace role ID.

200.description: Workspace role

id.description: Role ID. Pass it as `roleId` when you add or update a member; role names can change.

name.description: Role name. Organization administrators can rename it.

isDefault.description: True for a built-in role, which you can't edit or delete

items.description: A workspace permission key, e.g. "READ_DOCUMENT" or "SEND_DOCUMENT"

permissions.description: Permission keys granted by this role

patch.description:
Renames a role, replaces its permissions, or both. You can't edit a built-in role. To grant `ADMINISTRATOR`, you must hold it yourself.

**Permission required:** `MANAGE_WORKSPACE_ROLES` on the workspace.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The workspace role ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

permissions.description: Replacement set of permission keys. Omit to leave permissions unchanged.

items.description: A workspace permission key, e.g. "READ_DOCUMENT" or "SEND_DOCUMENT"

200.description: Workspace role

id.description: Role ID. Pass it as `roleId` when you add or update a member; role names can change.

name.description: Role name. Organization administrators can rename it.

isDefault.description: True for a built-in role, which you can't edit or delete

get.description:
List folders in the current workspace, optionally filtered by type (DOCUMENT or TEMPLATE) and parent folder.

Pass `parentFolderId` to list direct children of a specific folder. Omit it to list top-level folders. The newest folders come first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Return only DOCUMENT or TEMPLATE folders. Omit for both.

parameters.name: parentFolderId
parameters.description: Return only folders directly under this parent. Omit for top-level folders.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only folders created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only folders created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only folders updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only folders updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

200.description: List of folders

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder id, or null for top-level folders

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

createdBy.description: The user who created the folder

createdAt.description: When the folder was created.

updatedAt.description: When the folder was last updated.

childFolderCount.description: Number of folders directly in this folder, not counting trashed ones

itemCount.description: Number of documents or templates directly in this folder that you can see, not counting trashed or archived ones

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

post.description:
Create a new folder for documents or templates.

`type` selects which entity the folder organizes. Pass `parentFolderId` to nest under an existing folder.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version

get.description: Returns the comment threads on a document, newest first. Each item is a thread: the comment that opened it and its replies are in `messages`. Filter by `status` (`OPEN` or `RESOLVED`), or omit it for both.
get.summary: List comment threads on a document

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by thread status. Omit for both.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only threads created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only threads created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only threads updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only threads updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

status.description: Whether the thread is open or resolved.

visibility.description: If `SHARED`, every party on the document sees the thread. If `INTERNAL`, only the workspace does.

excerpt.description: The document text the thread refers to.

createdAt.description: When the comment thread was created.

updatedAt.description: When the comment thread was last updated.

resolvedAt.description: When the thread was resolved. Null while it's open.

createdBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

resolvedBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

parentId.description: The ID of the message this one replies to. Null for a top-level message.

mentions.description: IDs of the users the message mentions.

createdAt.description: When the message was created.

editedAt.description: When the message was last edited. Null if it never was.

deletedAt.description: When the message was deleted. Null if it wasn't.

type.description: Whether a workspace member, the AI assistant, or a party wrote the message.

id.description: The user or party ID. Null for the AI assistant, or when the author no longer exists.

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

messages.body: Kan vi ändra startdatum till den 1 december?

patch.summary: Resolve or reopen a comment thread

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: The comment thread ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

status.description: Mark thread as resolved or reopen it
Whether the thread is open or resolved.

visibility.description: If `SHARED`, every party on the document sees the thread. If `INTERNAL`, only the workspace does.

excerpt.description: The document text the thread refers to.

createdAt.description: When the comment thread was created.

updatedAt.description: When the comment thread was last updated.

resolvedAt.description: When the thread was resolved. Null while it's open.

createdBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

resolvedBy.description: Who wrote it. Null when the author no longer exists.

parentId.description: The ID of the message this one replies to. Null for a top-level message.

mentions.description: IDs of the users the message mentions.

createdAt.description: When the message was created.

editedAt.description: When the message was last edited. Null if it never was.

deletedAt.description: When the message was deleted. Null if it wasn't.

type.description: Whether a workspace member, the AI assistant, or a party wrote the message.

id.description: The user or party ID. Null for the AI assistant, or when the author no longer exists.

get.description: Returns a document's chat messages, newest first: external messages, which the parties see, and internal messages, which only the workspace sees. A party's private notes aren't included.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The document ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

internal.description: true = internal (workspace-only); false = external (visible to signers, sends notifications)

createdAt.description: When the message was created.

updatedAt.description: When the message was last updated.

author.description: Who wrote the message. Null when the author no longer exists.

type.description: Whether the author is a workspace member (USER) or a document signer (SIGNER)

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

get.description:
Returns the signature methods you can offer a signer, with display labels — the generic methods plus every currently-available eID scheme.

This is the *pickable* set, not every accepted value. `NONE` and `MANUAL` are still accepted on `requiredSignature` but are omitted here because the app derives them rather than offering them: `NONE` is what a party gets when its role isn't a signing role, and `MANUAL` is for an imported archive document that was already signed on paper.

Build signature-method pickers from this rather than hard-coding the list: eID schemes are switched on per market over time, and sending a scheme that isn't available yet is rejected with *"This eID scheme is not yet available"*.

`SE_BANKID` is Swedish BankID. API version `2026-09` calls it `BANKID`.

get.description:
Returns the values accepted by a party's `twoStepVerification` — the gate a signer passes *before* the document opens — with display labels.

Same rule as `/helpers/signature-methods`: build pickers from this rather than hard-coding, since the eID-backed gates become available as those schemes go live per market.

`SE_BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING` is Swedish BankID. API version `2026-09` calls it `BANKID_BEFORE_SIGNING`.

post.description:
Send manual reminders to signers on a PENDING document.

If `partyIds` is omitted, a reminder is sent to every signer that has not yet signed and is eligible: the document has been sent to them, and they have an address for the channel.

**Channel:** Each reminder goes out on the party's delivery method unless you set `channel` to `EMAIL` or `SMS`. A party without an address for that channel is skipped with reason `MISSING_EMAIL` or `MISSING_PHONE`. SMS reminders are billed like SMS invites.

**Rate limiting:** Each signer can only receive one reminder per 24 hours. Signers that are rate-limited or otherwise not eligible are returned in the response with `status: SKIPPED` and a `reason`.
post.summary: Send reminders to one or more signers

channel.description: Channel for the reminder. Defaults to each party's delivery method. A party without an address for the channel is skipped with reason `MISSING_EMAIL` or `MISSING_PHONE`. SMS reminders are billed like SMS invites.

get.description: Returns a webhook's deliveries from the last 7 days, newest first. A delivery is one event sent to this endpoint, with every attempt to send it in `attempts`. Filter by `type` or `status`, or by `eventId` to see what happened to one event.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by event type, such as `document.completed`. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Only deliveries of this event, the `id` from `GET /api/v1/events`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by delivery status: `SUCCESS`, `FAILED` or `PENDING`. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

id.description: ID of the delivery: one event sent to one endpoint, with every attempt to send it.

eventId.description: ID of the event, as `GET /api/v1/events/:id` takes it. Null for a delivery made before sajn recorded it.

type.description: The event type, such as `document.completed`. Null for an event type that 2026-10 no longer has.

status.description: `SUCCESS` when an attempt got a 2xx answer, `FAILED` when sajn stopped retrying, and `PENDING` while attempts remain.

url.description: The endpoint URL the delivery was sent to.

replayOfId.description: ID of the delivery this one replays. Null for an original delivery.

requestBody.description: The JSON body sent to the endpoint, in the webhook's API version. Null until the first attempt.

documentMeta.subject: Ditt anställningsavtal från Exempelbolaget AB
documentMeta.message: Hej Kai! Här är ditt anställningsavtal. Signera det med BankID senast den 28 oktober.

attempt.description: The attempt number, from 1. 0 for a delivery held back while the webhook was paused.

status.description: If `SUCCESS`, the endpoint answered with a 2xx status code.

responseCode.description: The HTTP status code the endpoint answered with, or 0 when no response arrived.

durationMs.description: How long the request took, in milliseconds. Null when sajn didn't send it, such as while the webhook was paused.

requestHeaders.description: The headers sajn sent. Null when sajn didn't send the request.

responseHeaders.description: The headers the endpoint answered with. Null when no response arrived.

responseBody.description: What the endpoint answered: the parsed JSON body, the text of a non-JSON body, or the network error when the request failed.

createdAt.description: When the webhook delivery was created.

attempts.description: Every attempt, oldest first. Empty until the first attempt.

createdAt.description: When the webhook delivery was created.

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.
