get.description:
Returns every event the workspace emitted in the last 30 days, newest first, whether or not a webhook was subscribed to it. Each event is the object a webhook delivery on your API version carries as its body.

If a webhook on API version `2026-10` was subscribed to the event type when the event happened, `data.object` is a snapshot from that moment. Otherwise sajn didn't record the object, and `data.object` is the resource as it is when you read the event. An event whose resource no longer exists is left out, so a page can hold fewer than `limit` events.

Pagination is keyset: follow `nextCursor` until it is `null`. New events arriving while you page never shift the window, so a full walk with `createdAfter` set to your last known timestamp is a complete reconcile even though webhooks are delivered at least once.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by event type, such as `document.completed`. Comma-separated or repeated.

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only events created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only events created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

id.description: Event ID. Every delivery of the event carries it in the body and the `webhook-id` header.

createdAt.description: When the event happened.

apiVersion.description: The API version that sets the shape of `data`.

environment.description: `SANDBOX` for an event in a sandbox organization.

type.description: `USER` for a member, `API_KEY` for an API key, `OAUTH_APP` for an OAuth application, and `SYSTEM` for sajn itself, such as a scheduled reminder.

id.description: ID of the user, API key or OAuth application. Null for `SYSTEM`.

actor.description: Who caused the event. Null when sajn can't attribute it: a party's action, such as signing, and most changes made in the sajn app.

data.description: The event's data, the same object a webhook delivery carries. `object` is the resource the event is about; the other fields depend on `type`.

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

get.description: Returns a single event, the same object a webhook delivery carries as its body. Use it to read an event again by the `webhook-id` of a delivery. `data.object` follows the same snapshot rule as `GET /api/v1/events`, and an event whose resource no longer exists returns `404`.

parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

get.description: Returns a webhook delivery with every attempt, including the request and response headers and bodies.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The webhook delivery ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

id.description: ID of the delivery: one event sent to one endpoint, with every attempt to send it.

eventId.description: ID of the event, as `GET /api/v1/events/:id` takes it. Null for a delivery made before sajn recorded it.

type.description: The event type, such as `document.completed`. Null for an event type that 2026-10 no longer has.

status.description: `SUCCESS` when an attempt got a 2xx answer, `FAILED` when sajn stopped retrying, and `PENDING` while attempts remain.

url.description: The endpoint URL the delivery was sent to.

replayOfId.description: ID of the delivery this one replays. Null for an original delivery.

requestBody.description: The JSON body sent to the endpoint, in the webhook's API version. Null until the first attempt.

documentMeta.subject: Ditt anställningsavtal från Exempelbolaget AB
documentMeta.message: Hej Kai! Här är ditt anställningsavtal. Signera det med BankID senast den 28 oktober.

attempt.description: The attempt number, from 1. 0 for a delivery held back while the webhook was paused.

status.description: If `SUCCESS`, the endpoint answered with a 2xx status code.

responseCode.description: The HTTP status code the endpoint answered with, or 0 when no response arrived.

durationMs.description: How long the request took, in milliseconds. Null when sajn didn't send it, such as while the webhook was paused.

requestHeaders.description: The headers sajn sent. Null when sajn didn't send the request.

responseHeaders.description: The headers the endpoint answered with. Null when no response arrived.

responseBody.description: What the endpoint answered: the parsed JSON body, the text of a non-JSON body, or the network error when the request failed.

createdAt.description: When the webhook delivery was created.

attempts.description: Every attempt, oldest first. Empty until the first attempt.

createdAt.description: When the webhook delivery was created.

post.description:
Sends a past delivery again, with the body it had, and returns the new delivery with `status: PENDING` and no attempts. Its `replayOfId` is this delivery's ID, and its attempts appear in `GET /api/v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId` once sajn sends it. The event `id`, and so `webhook-id`, stays the same, so a receiver that deduplicates on it ignores the replay of an event it already processed.

Returns `409 INVALID_STATE` when the webhook is disabled or paused, or the delivery is older than 7 days. Reactivate a paused webhook with `POST /api/v1/webhooks/:id/reactivate` first.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The webhook ID.

parameters.name: deliveryId
parameters.description: The webhook delivery ID.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries safe. A retry with the same key and the same request replays the stored response for 24 hours (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); the same key with a different request returns 400.

id.description: ID of the delivery: one event sent to one endpoint, with every attempt to send it.

eventId.description: ID of the event, as `GET /api/v1/events/:id` takes it. Null for a delivery made before sajn recorded it.

type.description: The event type, such as `document.completed`. Null for an event type that 2026-10 no longer has.

status.description: `SUCCESS` when an attempt got a 2xx answer, `FAILED` when sajn stopped retrying, and `PENDING` while attempts remain.

url.description: The endpoint URL the delivery was sent to.

replayOfId.description: ID of the delivery this one replays. Null for an original delivery.

requestBody.description: The JSON body sent to the endpoint, in the webhook's API version. Null until the first attempt.

requestHeaders.description: The headers sajn sent. Null when sajn didn't send the request.

responseHeaders.description: The headers the endpoint answered with. Null when no response arrived.

responseBody.description: What the endpoint answered: the parsed JSON body, the text of a non-JSON body, or the network error when the request failed.

attempts.description: Every attempt, oldest first. Empty until the first attempt.

reason.description: Why the party delegated, as the party wrote it.

status.description: Where the delegation stands.

expiresAt.description: When the delegate's invitation expires.

get.description:
List reusable content blocks (library entries) visible to the authenticated user.

Blocks come in their library order (`sortOrder`), then newest first. Filter by `visibility`, or omit it for every block you can see:
- `PRIVATE`: your private blocks in this workspace
- `WORKSPACE`: blocks shared at workspace level
- `ORGANIZATION`: blocks shared at organization level
- `SHARED`: blocks sajn curates for everyone

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous response, to get the next page. Keep the other parameters unchanged.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `total` adds the number of items that match the filters. Counting takes time, so ask for it only when you need it.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text search across name, description, and field metadata

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Returns only blocks in this category.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Returns only blocks in this language, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Returns only blocks with this `visibility`. Omit for every block you can see.

parameters.name: fieldType
parameters.description: Filter to blocks whose single field has this FieldType

parameters.name: createdAfter
parameters.description: Only blocks created at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: createdBefore
parameters.description: Only blocks created at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: updatedAfter
parameters.description: Only blocks updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or date-time. Use it for incremental sync.

parameters.name: updatedBefore
parameters.description: Only blocks updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: API version for this request. Without it, the request uses the organization's default version; an organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request.

visibility.description: `PRIVATE` for your own blocks in this workspace, `WORKSPACE` for blocks shared in the workspace, `ORGANIZATION` for blocks shared across the organization, and `SHARED` for the blocks sajn curates for everyone.

language.description: The block's language, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`.

name.description: Full name. Null when the user has no name.

createdBy.description: The user who created the block

createdAt.description: When the block was created.

updatedAt.description: When the block was last updated.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content, in the same shape as a document field's `fieldMeta`.

hasMore.description: True if more items follow this page.

nextCursor.description: Pass this as `cursor` to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: The number of items that match the filters. Present only with `include=total`.

info.title: sajn API
info.description:
# sajn - API v1

With the sajn REST API, you can add digital document signing to your own applications.

## Overview

sajn is a Swedish digital document signing platform. With the API, you can:
- Create and manage documents and templates
- Add the parties who sign, review, or organize a document
- Send documents for signing by email or SMS
- Track document status and signatures
- Manage contacts and companies
- Organize documents with tags and custom fields
- Verify identities with sajn ID, through BankID and other eIDs

## Authentication

Every endpoint (except the health check) requires a bearer token in the Authorization header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN
```

Two kinds of token are accepted:

- **Personal API key** (`sajn_sk_...`) — generated from your workspace developer settings. Acts as the issuing user; can reach any endpoint the user's workspace role permits.
- **OAuth 2.0 access token** — issued via the authorization-code flow (PKCE for public clients) to a connected application. Bound to one workspace and limited to the **scopes** the user granted at consent — effective access is *workspace role ∩ granted scopes*.

Each operation lists the OAuth scopes it requires in its security section. The scopes are coarse and resource-oriented (e.g. `documents:read`, `documents:write`, `documents:delete`, `contacts:read`). Personal API keys are not scope-limited; OAuth tokens are.

## Rate Limiting

Limits apply per organization and scale with the plan:

| Plan | Per minute | Per day |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | 60 | 2 000 |
| Solo | 120 | 10 000 |
| Team | 600 | 100 000 |
| Enterprise | 2 000 | 2 000 000 |
| Sandbox | 60 | 2 000 |

Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` for the minute window, and `X-RateLimit-Daily-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Daily-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Daily-Reset` for the daily quota. A `429` response includes `Retry-After` in seconds.

## Query parameters

Query parameters are plain strings, such as `?externalId=12345&archived=false`:
- Booleans are `true` or `false`.
- Dates are ISO 8601 dates (`2026-10-01`) or date-times (`2026-10-01T08:00:00Z`). A date-time without an offset is UTC.
- Filters that take several values accept a comma-separated list (`status=PENDING,COMPLETED`) or a repeated parameter (`status=PENDING&status=COMPLETED`).

An unknown query parameter returns `400`, so a misspelled filter never silently returns everything.

## Pagination

Every list returns `{ data, hasMore, nextCursor }`. To walk a list, pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` on the next request, keep the other parameters unchanged, and stop when `hasMore` is `false`. `limit` sets the page size, from 1 to 100, with a default of 25. To get the number of items that match the filters, pass `include=total`, and the response adds `total`.

Lists sort newest first. To sort another way, pass `orderBy` and `orderDirection` where the list takes them. A list bounded by its parent, such as a document's parties, returns every item in one response, with `hasMore` set to `false` and `nextCursor` set to `null`.

On the documents list, the cursor is keyset-based: it stays correct while documents are created and updated between requests. To mirror documents into your own system, sort by `updatedAt` and use the `updatedAfter` filter.

## Idempotent requests

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string up to 255 characters, for example a UUID) on `POST`, `PATCH` or `DELETE` requests to make retries safe. The first request runs normally and its response is stored for 24 hours, errors included. A retry with the same key and the same method, path and body returns the stored response with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Reusing a key with a different request returns `400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; retrying while the first request is still running returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE` with `Retry-After`. Responses with a `429` or `5xx` status aren't stored, so the retry runs again. Keys are scoped to the workspace.

## Versioning

The API is versioned by date (`YYYY-MM`), and this reference documents version `2026-10`. To choose the version for a request, send the `Sajn-Version` header:

```
Sajn-Version: 2026-10
```

Without the header, a request uses your organization's default version. An organization without a default is pinned to the latest version by its first request. Every response returns the version that served it in `Sajn-Version`. On a deprecated version, responses also carry `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers, and from the sunset date its requests return `400`. For details, see https://docs.sajn.se/api-reference/versioning.

## Webhooks

Each webhook endpoint has its own API version, set when you create it, that decides the payload shape. Deliveries carry it in the `Sajn-Version` header.

The delivery body is the event, `{ id, type, createdAt, apiVersion, workspaceId, environment, actor, data }`, signed according to [Standard Webhooks](https://www.standardwebhooks.com) in the `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` headers. Common document events:
- `document.created` - A document is created.
- `document.sent` - A document is sent for signing.
- `document.party.opened` - A party opens the document.
- `document.party.signed` - A party signs the document.
- `document.fully_signed` - Every signer has signed, before the document is sealed.
- `document.completed` - The document is sealed and complete.
- `document.rejected` - A party rejects the document.

For every event type, see `POST /api/v1/webhooks`.

## Error Handling

Every error response has the same JSON shape:

```json
{
  "code": "NOT_FOUND",
  "message": "Document not found",
  "userMessage": "Dokumentet hittades inte.",
  "requestId": "req_V1StGXR8Z5jdHi6BmyT2",
  "resource": "document"
}
```

- `code` is always present and comes from the closed list in the following table. Branch on it, not on the status or the message.
- `message` is English text for developers. When the operation has no more specific text, it's the meaning of `code` from the following table. Its wording can change, so don't parse it.
- `userMessage` is always present. It's text that is safe to show your users, usually in Swedish.
- `requestId` identifies the request and matches the `Sajn-Request-Id` header, which every response carries. Quote it when you contact support. On a replayed idempotent response, it identifies the original request.

A `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` lists every problem in `issues`: `[{ "path": "parties.0.email", "code": "INVALID_FORMAT", "message": "Invalid email address" }]`. An issue `code` is one of `INVALID_TYPE`, `INVALID_FORMAT`, `INVALID_VALUE`, `TOO_SMALL`, `TOO_BIG` or `UNRECOGNIZED_KEY`, and an issue that no single input caused has an empty `path`. A `404 NOT_FOUND` names the type of the missing resource in `resource`, such as `document` or `party`, or `null` when the API can't tell. A `403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` includes `requiredScopes` and `grantedScopes`.

A `401 UNAUTHORIZED` always means the credential itself is missing, invalid, expired or revoked. A valid token that isn't allowed to do something gets a `403`. A `409 INVALID_STATE` means the resource's state doesn't allow the operation; change the state first, then retry. A `503 UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` is safe to retry with exponential backoff, and so is a `429` after `Retry-After` seconds.

The API returns the following codes:

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | 400 | The request failed validation. `issues` lists every problem. |
| `INVALID_JSON` | 400 | The request body isn't valid JSON. |
| `EXPIRED` | 400 | The link, code or resource has expired. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` | 400 | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different request. |
| `INVALID_API_VERSION` | 400 | The `Sajn-Version` header names a version that doesn't exist. |
| `API_VERSION_SUNSET` | 400 | The requested version, or your organization's default, is past its sunset date. |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | The API token is missing, invalid, expired or revoked. |
| `PERMISSION_DENIED` | 403 | The token's user isn't allowed to perform the operation, for example because their workspace role lacks a permission. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` | 403 | The OAuth token wasn't granted a scope the operation requires. See `requiredScopes` and `grantedScopes`. |
| `PLAN_REQUIRED` | 403 | The organization's plan doesn't include API access or the feature. |
| `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE` | 403 | The organization, user or membership behind the token is deactivated or suspended. |
| `ACCOUNT_SETUP_REQUIRED` | 403 | The organization must finish its setup, such as verifying an accountable person, first. |
| `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | 403 | A plan limit was reached, such as the monthly number of sent documents. |
| `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` | 409 | The operation needs an approval first, such as sending a document that the workspace requires an approval for. Request one with `POST /api/v1/approval-requests`. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | The resource doesn't exist, or the token can't access it. `resource` names its type, such as `document`, or is `null` when the API can't tell. |
| `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No endpoint matches the method and path in the requested API version. |
| `INVALID_STATE` | 409 | The resource's current state doesn't allow the operation, such as editing a document that was already sent or downloading a file that isn't produced yet. |
| `ALREADY_EXISTS` | 409 | A resource with the same unique value, such as `externalId`, already exists. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE` | 409 | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | The per-minute rate limit was reached. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | 429 | The daily request quota was reached. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds. |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Something went wrong on sajn's side. Quote `requestId` when you contact support. |
| `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | A service the operation depends on, such as an eID provider or a connected integration, failed or is unavailable. Retry with exponential backoff. |

## Support

For API support, documentation, or questions:
- Email: dev@sajn.se
- Documentation: https://docs.sajn.se
- Status: https://status.sajn.se

bearerAuth.description: Personal API key, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer sajn_sk_...`. Not scope-limited — acts as the issuing user.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 access token for a connected application. Limited to the scopes granted at consent.

scopes.profile:read: Read the user's profile, including name, phone number and email address.
scopes.documents:write: Create documents and edit the documents the user created.
scopes.documents:delete: Delete documents, files, folders, custom fields and comment threads.
scopes.forms:delete: Permanently delete forms and their submissions.
scopes.forms:submissions:read: Read form submissions and the respondents' contact details.
scopes.audit:read: Read document activity and event logs.
scopes.signatures:read: Read the identity the eID verified at signing, including the national identity number.
scopes.login:read: Read the result of sajn Login sessions.
scopes.actions:read: Read suggested actions and what each one does.
scopes.actions:write: Approve, dismiss and snooze suggested actions. An approval can send reminders to counterparties, terminate agreements and create follow-ups.
scopes.roles:read: Read the workspace's roles and permissions.
scopes.roles:write: Create, edit and delete workspace roles.

type.description: `USER` for a member, `API_KEY` for an API key, `OAUTH_APP` for an OAuth application, and `SYSTEM` for sajn itself, such as a scheduled reminder.

id.description: ID of the user, API key or OAuth application. Null for `SYSTEM`.

WebhookActor.description: Who caused the event. Null when sajn can't attribute it: a party's action, such as signing, and most changes made in the sajn app.

externalId.description: Your external reference ID for this document

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the document expires

status.description: Document status

documentMeta.description: Document metadata including subject, message, signing order, etc.

subject.description: Email subject line when sending document

message.description: Custom message included in signing invitation

signingMode.description: How the parties sign: PARALLEL, all at once, or SEQUENTIAL, one at a time in the order of each party's `signingOrder`

forceReadFullDocument.description: Whether signers must read the entire document before signing

showChatToSigners.description: Whether to show document chat to signers

language.description: Language of the signing page and the emails to the parties, an ISO 639-1 code such as `sv`

value.description: The document's value, such as a contract amount, as free text. It isn't an amount of money in minor units.

redirectUrl.description: URL to redirect signers to after signing is complete. New values must be http(s); legacy values are returned as stored.

redirectEnabled.description: Whether redirect after signing is enabled

internalRecipients.description: Email addresses that receive a copy of the sealed PDF once the document is completed

signableAfterExpired.description: Whether the document remains signable after its expiration date

sendPlainTextEmailOnly.description: Send plain text email invitations only (no HTML). null inherits the workspace default.

reminderIntervalDays.description: Days between automatic reminders. `0` turns them off, and null uses the default of 3.

allowDelegation.description: Whether signers may delegate signing to another person

accessVerification.description: Document-wide verification required to open the document

aiChatEnabled.description: Whether the signer-facing AI chat is enabled. null inherits the workspace default.

nationalIdDisplayMode.description: How national identity numbers are displayed to signers: FULL, PARTIAL, or NONE. null inherits the workspace default.

sameDeviceSigning.description: Whether all parties sign in sequence on one device

documentCategoryId.description: Document category (Dokumenttyp) scoping which custom fields apply. See GET /api/v1/document-categories.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the document was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the document was last updated

completedAt.description: Date and time when all signers completed signing

deletedAt.description: Date and time when the document moved to the trash, or null when it isn't in the trash

templateId.description: ID of the template the document was created from, or null

folderId.description: ID of the folder that holds the document, or null at the top level

responsibleUserId.description: ID of the workspace member responsible for the document

parties.description: Array of document parties (signers and other participants).

fields.description: Content blocks in position order when you pass `expand=fields`, and null otherwise. See the field endpoints for the per-type shapes.

templateId.description: Template this field belongs to

position.description: 0-based order of the field among the document's content blocks

value.description: The file the party uploaded. Set by sajn when the upload is confirmed; a request can't set it.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

pricesIncludeVat.description: If `true`, the entered prices include VAT. If `false`, they exclude it. Default: `false`.

defaultVatRate.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`, for a product without its own `vat`. Default: `25`.

showVatBreakdown.description: If `true`, the totals show the VAT amount. Default: `true`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, such as `SEK`. Every price in the table is a decimal amount in this currency.

price.description: Unit price as a decimal amount in the table's `currency`, such as `1499.5`, not in minor units. It excludes VAT unless `pricing.pricesIncludeVat` is `true`.

vat.description: VAT rate in percent, such as `25`. Without it, `pricing.defaultVatRate` applies.

fieldMeta.description: Type-specific content. For PDF fields this includes `placedFields` (boxes placed on the PDF pages) and `formFields` (form fields extracted from the PDF).

createdAt.description: Date and time when the field was created

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the field was last updated

fieldMeta.content: Anställningen gäller tills vidare från och med den 1 november 2026, med sex månaders provanställning.

productTables.description: Every product table on the document, resolved: each row carries the recipient's final `selected` state and `quantity`, and the totals count the selected rows only. Empty when the document has no product table.

approvalRequestId.description: ID of the document's approval request, or null when it has none. To read it, call `GET /api/v1/approval-requests/{id}`.

documentId.description: The ID of the document the party belongs to

post.description: Fires when a document is created, including when a document is duplicated or created from an attachment emailed to the workspace inbox; `data.source` says which. The document is usually still a `DRAFT`. Use it to link the document to a record in your system, for example through `externalId`.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: The event `id`. It stays the same across retries and replays, so deduplicate on it.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: When sajn sent this attempt, in Unix seconds. Reject a timestamp older than your tolerance, such as five minutes.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: One or more space-separated signatures, `v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>`, over `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw request body>`. The key is the base64 decoding of the secret after `whsec_`. Accept the request when any signature matches; for 24 hours after a secret rotation, there is one per secret. Any Standard Webhooks library verifies it. Webhooks created without a secret don't send this header.

parameters.name: Sajn-Version
parameters.description: The endpoint's API version, the same value as `apiVersion` in the body.

id.description: Event ID, also in `webhook-id`. It's the same on every retry, replay and endpoint that receives the event, so deduplicate on it. To read the event again, pass it to `GET /api/v1/events/{id}`.

createdAt.description: When the event happened. It doesn't change across retries and replays.

apiVersion.description: The endpoint's API version, which sets the shape of `data`.

environment.description: `SANDBOX` for an event in a sandbox organization.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: When sajn sent this attempt, in Unix seconds. Reject a timestamp older than your tolerance, such as five minutes.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: One or more space-separated signatures, `v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>`, over `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw request body>`. The key is the base64 decoding of the secret after `whsec_`. Accept the request when any signature matches; for 24 hours after a secret rotation, there is one per secret. parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: The event `id`. It stays the same across retries and replays, so deduplicate on it.

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: When sajn sent this attempt, in Unix seconds. Reject a timestamp older than your tolerance, such as five minutes.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: One or more space-separated signatures, `v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>`, over `<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw request body>`.
